body.x: Exosystems has and presented exoRehab for occupational therapy in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK MIK Innovation Hot Spot & MIK Night (Booth #52843), the world’s largest technology exhibition held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).

With the increase of worldwide aging population, most patients or seniors are suffering from loss of proper physical function. To supplement and assist those with a physical limitation, Exosystems aims to further enhance the treatment through robotics and AI technology.

ExoRehab, compared to other existing devices for musculoskeletal occupational therapy, provides remedial exercise for joint areas, electrotherapy, EMG signal measurement, and other diverse functions at the same time which allows more efficient usage.

By providing a tablet installed with a program related to occupational therapy, it enables the patients to carry on their remedial exercise; also, level of performance and enhancement of the exercise can be analyzed through data which is another advantage.
